'''Hilda rolls''' (German: Hildabrötchen) are German [[Cookbook:Sandwich Cookie|sandwich cookies]] filled with jam. They are very similar to, and perhaps interchangeable with, Linzer cookies.

==Ingredients==
*300 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]], [[Cookbook:Sifting|sifted]]
*110 g white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*1 package [[Cookbook:Vanilla Sugar|vanilla sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*150 g [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*125 g [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
*2 spoons water
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] the flour, butter, sugar, vanilla sugar, and egg into a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. Chill for a while.
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] the dough to about ¼ [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] thick.
# Cut round cookies out of the dough. For half the cookies, cut a small shape out of the middle—these will be the tops.
# Place the cookies on a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|tray]] and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 150°C for about 20 minutes. Let cool.
# Combine the powdered sugar and water to make a smooth [[Cookbook:Icing|icing]]. Carefully dip the top cookies in the icing to coat one face.
# Spread some jam on the bottom layer cookies. Top with the iced cutout cookies.
